p: mother: Meaning, Israel and Judah who both came out of one family.
Egypt: They became idolaters after the manner of the Egyptians.

them were Aholah the elder: Aholah signifies a mansion or dwelling in herself, meaning Samaria, which was the royal city of Israel and Aholibah signifies my mansion in her, by which is meant Jerusalem, where God's temple was.
she was mine: When the Israelites were named the people of God, they became idolaters and forsook God, and put their trust in the Assyrians.
lay with her: The Holy Spirit uses these terms which seem strange to chaste ears, to cause this wicked vice of idolatry to be so abhorred that no one could stand to hear the name of it.
they had executed judgment upon her: Meaning the Assyrians.

portrayed upon the wall: This declares that no words are able to sufficiently express the rage of idolaters and therefore the Holy Spirit here compares them to those who in their raging love and filthy lusts dote on the images and paintings of them after whom they lust.
Pekod: These were the names of certain princes and captains under Nebuchadnezzar.
nose and thy ears: They will destroy your princes and priests with the rest of your people.
labour: All your treasures and riches which you have gotten by labour.
shall be uncovered: All the world will see your shameful forsaking of God to serve idols.
cup into thy hand: I will execute the same judgments and vengeance against you and that with greater severity.
drunkenness and sorrow: Meaning that it's afflictions would be so great that they would cause them to lose their senses and reason.
devour them: That is, to be sacrifices to their idols, read Eze 16:20.
far: They sent into other countries to have such as would teach the service of their idols.
upon a stately bed: He means the altar that was prepared for the idols.
Sabeans from the wilderness: Who would teach the manner of worshipping their gods.
adulteresses: That is worthy of death, Eze 16:38.
women may be taught not to: Meaning, all other cities and countries.
